name: Medical device adverse event reports by product code and quarter (FDA MAUDE via openFDA)
description: Adverse event reports the FDA received about medical devices, counted by device product code and calendar quarter from 2025 Q1: reports, deaths, injuries, malfunctions and other, for the 300 product codes with the most reports and for all devices together. Counted with the openFDA device event API (licence CC0); no report row, narrative, patient or manufacturer is ever read, only counts. Reports are filed up to weeks after an event and are driven by litigation and recalls as well as by harm, so a count is not an incidence rate.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Medical device adverse event reports by product code and quarter (FDA MAUDE via openFDA) (Version 2.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23963431
keywords: FDA MAUDE adverse event reports by product code
medical device adverse events by quarter

distribution.name: device-events.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: device-events.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: device-events-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in device-events-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to device-events.csv on id.

recordSet.name: device-events
recordSet.description: The records of Medical device adverse event reports by product code and quarter (FDA MAUDE via openFDA), one per CSV row.

field.name: id
field.description: Stable record id: dataset, place and period

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: US for every record (the data are national)

field.name: level
field.description: product-code or us (all device product codes together)

field.name: deviceName
field.description: Device name for the product code from the FDA classification database

field.name: quarter
field.description: Calendar quarter of the date the FDA received the report, such as 2026Q2

field.name: year
field.description: Calendar year of the quarter

field.name: qtr
field.description: Quarter number 1 to 4

field.name: periodStart
field.description: First day of the quarter

field.name: periodEnd
field.description: Last day of the quarter

field.name: status
field.description: P: counted from the primary source

field.name: text
field.description: One plain sentence with the quarter's counts

field.name: value
field.description: Same as reports

field.name: unit
field.description: What value counts

field.name: reports
field.description: Adverse event reports (MDRs) the FDA received in the quarter for the product code; counted once per report that lists the code

field.name: deaths
field.description: Reports whose event type is Death

field.name: injuries
field.description: Reports whose event type is Injury

field.name: malfunctions
field.description: Reports whose event type is Malfunction

field.name: other
field.description: reports less deaths, injuries and malfunctions: Other, No answer provided, and the few reports with no event type

field.name: effectiveFrom
field.description: Same as periodStart

field.name: effectiveTo
field.description: Same as periodEnd

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: Date the openFDA API was last read

field.name: sourceLabels
field.description: Sources, separated by " | "

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
